notes.title: Another 2.0 fix
notes.content:
Hello, here another fix of major issues detected in the game : 

[u]Fixed :[/u]
• Multiplayer Achievement wasn't trigerring when you was taking the trophy  : "The Stupid Mistake".
• Robert the kidnapper, was starting to chase the player after 1 min of gameplay in the normal map.
• Fixed the crow flight that was failing due to collisions with the frontal lamp.
• Fixed the slowmotion of low fps rate.
[i]• Many little fix can come later if they are not important, they will be added to that list.[/i]

• Added a flash light due to, many feedback (Couldn't make the night more bright so I added this function) : Now use L to activate a frontal light in the story mode.

notes.title: 2.0 Fix
notes.content:
[u]Fixed :[/u] 
• Coins display in pause menu
• Access to underworld when already owning the achievement
• Multiplayer server display of name, players and ping
• Respawn of the player with the correct skin
• Sound issues
• Death animations of skins (Not perfect but it will do the job)
• Ben & Nuts now hunt player while they're jumping

[u]Known bug :[/u]
• Voice chat Echoe
• Death aniomation don't have the upper body animation on skins


► This will hopefully be the last update for a long time.
[i]If there is any major issue I will take the time to fix them.[/i]

notes.title: Maze Mart 2.0 !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617047/6ca85a3940b8ca7d75e2d5e1e6a32caf2d5404aa.jpg[/img]

It's finally here ! And it will make a break in the game's update for few month or more [i](I'm moving to another project, if there is bug to fix it may be fixed depending of it's category[/i]).

[h2]Enhance :[/h2]
► Added a new level : Isaac is being kidnapped for having crossing the line ! This include 3 new achievement, and a new game mechanic inside a maze.

• Changed the way to get a coin in the first level by addign a new hidden quest-line.
• Upgraded the night "brightness" to make everything visible at night (Even the dancing npc that were hiding in the darkness of the night :O)
• Fixed the coin bug that was destroyed.
• Added a respawn function if the player get destroyed by any reasons.
• Fixed all the achievement issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617047/40cdb606ec032d62c69f0f648315db0a10f6559e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Multiplayer :[/h2]
► Same map as the demo multiplayer
► Same achievements
► Character selection based on the achievement you've unlocked in story mode.

• Discord notifier in the community server of people that win the multiplayer trophy.
• Known bug : Echoes during the voice chat.
• The hidden keys are only inside the demo maze.


• The three winner of the Maze Mart Challenge release event will be permanently in the spawn, with a commemorative trophy above ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617047/bb5f31cf9b6592ddbb623a5fc66846d036e8209f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617047/b6d3a9617dd626c80edeb285116b229c8d764816.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Maze Mart Challenge : Demo !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617047/03052adcc9c716ec243e22373a60733ad3cb12ac.png[/img]

Dear curious players, for the release of the multiplayer challenge in the game demo, I decided to make a special release event and reward the community of the game, to thank you playing it !

[h1]The Demo Challenge ![/h1]
You and your friends will coop or fight to reach the last trophy, through 3 massive maze and 3 bosses room ! Can you reach it ?
Only the first player to touch the trophy will get rewarded !
On top of that he will unlock a shiny crown above his head to show that he completed the challenge !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617047/ffcb410051e94d3c5617c7a6cdb9d1fd1ab0a607.png[/img]

The challenge contain many traps top slow your progression. And some filthy bosses that hit you hard !
If you manage to dodge the twins, you will have to get a key inside a Kraken... and if you manage by any miracle to get it and open the door....
Oh boy, the last boss room, a magic cube flying above lava, that contain the trophy.

Good luck, and have a lot of fun !

[h2]The Prize[/h2]
Here is the prize for the top 3 player to reach the trophy the first (respecting the game's rules) :
[olist]
[*] 1 Steam Gift Card of 25$, 1 Game key and 1 Discord Title
[*] 1 Game key and 1 Discord Title
[*] 1 Game key and 1 Discord Title
[/olist]

To all player, a key may be hidden deep inside the maze ;)

All the players that reach the end trophy get their nickname registered on the discord server and the time they took to get it !

[h2]The Multiplayer servers[/h2]
The servers can hold 100 players (It could increase or decrease depending the feedbacks), player are allowed to join any server that already started and a proximity chat have been set (as long as a keyboard one).
Don't get surprised if time to time an admin come spectate you ;)

[h2]It's free to participate : All take place in the DEMO ![/h2]
And yes, anybody can participate for free to this challenge ! Because everything take place in the demo :)
If you have the complete version and cannot download the demo again, join the discord, a tutorial explain how to redownload steam demo via console.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617047/958029070db3bc5aeea530978c9d16835cd452e5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617047/245cb3984ca8e181c0ddc94c4ee77e6f27785c32.png[/img]




[url=https://discord.gg/aWrWyxhzpP  style=button]Join the Discord to register ![/url] 
[i](If you want to redeem a reward in case of winning) Or if you have any question, or want to share with the community.[/i]

[url=https://www.pimeine.com/en/mazemartchallenge.php  style=button]The website page of the rules.[/url]
[i]You will know more about the prize and the rules of the event there.[/i]

notes.title: Special event on the Demo soon !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617047/3ef2317639120a2c87e4be735f4d8d18c8f31d3f.png[/img]

Hello everybody,
I'm working on a big update for the demo !

This will be a special event for every players (that own the complete game or not) and will grant you some rewards !

[h2]The Challenge[/h2]
[h3]When ?[/h3]
The sever of the challenge will open only the days of the event.

[h3]How to access it ?[/h3]
• First join the discord server to register [i](it's free)[/i] to the player list : https://discord.com/invite/aWrWyxhzpP ; to register to the player list you will need the role "Maze Mart Challenger".
• Then in-game, after the update the challenge connexion button will appear in [b]the main menu of the Demo[/b].
• And thats it, all the event organisation will be detailed on the discord server soon.
(To access the challenge you will need a login password that will be shared to the registered player list)

[h3]The Challenge ?[/h3]
You and all the other players will enter inside Isaac's head... And you'll need to wake up. The only way to wake up, beat the last boss and complete the challenge.

► You will all spawn in a cage in the first stage of the challenge. When it will be the time to start, the cage will dissapear and you will be able to run for the first place ! [i](Be careful of the traps !)[/i]
► Once a boss is defeated, and the first player reached the next stage, a respawn point will be added in the 2 min near the entrance of this stage.
► Many buff will appear in the map, they will help you to be the first.

[h2]The rewards :[/h2]
Game key and Unique achievement for the complete game.
[h3]The game key[/h3]
3 game key will be inside this challenge, and a key will be given to the first player that reach a boss.
[h3]The achievement[/h3]
This special achievement "Challenger of the insanity" is not a simple achievement, it will grant to the player that own it to access a secret challenge in the complete game ! ːsteamhappyː
[i]To get this achievement, the players need to beat the last boss, if the boss is defeated, all the registered players (Online or not) will get the achievement.[/i]

==============================================================================
If some of you are entertained by this event let me know ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Maze Mart v1.2
notes.content:
Hello everybody, here is the 1.2 Update !

► Bug fixed :
[list]
[*] Achievement index fixed [i](Wrong achievement were given due to an index gap between the game and steam, you keep the unlocked achievement)[/i]
[/list]
► Underworld :
[list]
[*] A post-it help have been added near the crow mount, to understand how to unlock it. (Another post-it have been added to the required item location in the first level).
[*] The Ghost Guide have been updated, an arrow now point where his arm is pointing.
[*] Demonic Coins have been updated to not eventually spawn under the ground, and some have been moved to easier spots.
[*] No more Light spot infront the player spawn, to not trick him.
[/list]
► Overall :
[list]
[*] Night brightness have been doubled, due to some negative feedback about it.
[/list]
